metadata.title: Jaylen Wright - Nursing multiple injuries
metadata.description: Wright (stinger/foot) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.
metadata.analysis: Wright was forced out of Sunday's loss at San Francisco early with a stinger, and it looks like he might have picked up a foot issue along the way as well. He'll likely have to manage a full practice Thursday or Friday to avoid carrying an injury designation into the weekend.

metadata.title: Jaylen Wright (stinger) to be limited in practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Jaylen Wright will be limited for Wednesday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Wright's status is up in the air heading into Week 3.

metadata.title: Jaylen Wright - Considered day-to-day
metadata.description: Wright (neck) is day-to-day heading into Week 3, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
metadata.analysis: Wright suffered a stinger during Sunday's 35-13 loss to the 49ers, and he finished his day having turned two carries into 11 yards while also adding 79 kickoff-return yards. The running back's status at the team's first practice of the week Wednesday will shed some more light on his chances to play Week 3 versus the Chiefs.

metadata.title: Jaylen Wright is Considered Day-to-Day
metadata.description: Miami Dolphins running back Jaylen Wright (neck) is considered day-to-day after suffering an injury during Sunday's game against the San Francisco 49ers, per David Furones. Wright was forced to exit Sunday's contest after sustaining a neck injury. It remains to be seen if Wright will be healthy enough to play against the Kansas City Chiefs in Week 3. Wright hasn't been fantasy relevant during the first two games, but he would have an expanded role if De'Von Achane ever misses time. Fantasy managers will need to check back on Wednesday when the first practice of the week begins.

metadata.title: Jaylen Wright (neck/shoulder) day-to-day
metadata.description: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Jaylen Wright is day-to-day.
metadata.analysis: Wright left Sunday's game early with a neck/shoulder injury.

metadata.title: Jaylen Wright - Exits game with stinger
metadata.description: Wright (neck) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the 49ers.
metadata.analysis: Wright logged two carries for 11 yards prior to going to the locker room, where he's undergoing more tests to determine the severity of his injury and whether he can return to Sunday's game. Ollie Gordon should see an uptick in backfield snaps behind starter De'Von Achane for as long as Wright is out of the game.

metadata.title: Jaylen Wright Suffers Neck Injury Against 49ers
metadata.description: Miami Dolphins running back Jaylen Wright (neck) exited Sunday's 35-13 loss to the San Francisco 49ers with a neck stinger he suffered in the first half. The Dolphins designated Wright's status as questionable, but he did not appear to return to the game. Following the loss, Miami head coach Jeff Hafley said that he did not have an update on Wright, according to Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald. Wright finished his day with two carries for 11 yards. He was not targeted in the passing game. As expected, De'Von Achane led the Dolphins in rushing with 20 carries for 74 yards, while adding three receptions for 19 yards. Ollie Gordon II saw three carries for seven yards and is the name to watch for a slight uptick in usage should Wright miss any time.

metadata.title: Jaylen Wright Is In a Very Limited Role
metadata.description: Miami Dolphins running back Jaylen Wright earned the team's backup spot in the backfield, but in Week 1, he was a non-factor. While even starting RB De'Von Achane didn't get much going against the Raiders, Wright only played four snaps (7%) and lost a yard on his only carry. Wright has shown enough upside to be more than just a handcuff, but he can't be a fantasy factor unless he gets a much bigger workload. The Dolphins are expected to have a run-heavy attack, but most of the work looks like it will go to Achane and QB Malik Willis. In Week 2's matchup against the 49ers, Wright is only the RB68 in RotoBaller's rankings, indicating that he's best left on the bench or the waiver wire until his workload shifts significantly.

metadata.title: Jaylen Wright - Minimal usage in loss
metadata.description: Wright had two kick returns for 106 yards alongside one carry for a one-yard loss in Sunday's 27-13 loss to the Raiders.
metadata.analysis: Wright was an afterthought behind starting running back De'Von Achane, who had 11 carries and five targets in the loss. The No. 2 option will likely make a living as a returner, as it appears he currently has no niche in the offense or as a regular participant with the special teams unit.

metadata.title: Jaylen Wright sees one carry in Week 1
metadata.description: Jaylen Wright rushed once for a loss of one yard in the Dolphins' 27-13 loss to the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 1.
metadata.analysis: Wright was non-existent in the Miami ground attack, finishing behind De'Von Achane and Malik Willis in carries and rushing yards in the loss. The running back remains difficult to trust as part of a Miami offense looking for answers after Week 1, with the San Francisco 49ers up next in Week 2.
